evals.prompt: I need to find 20 US fitness creators on YouTube who focus on home workouts. They should have at least 50k subscribers and decent engagement.
evals.expected_output: Run search directly with inferred parameters and present a readable shortlist
expectations: Infers platform=YOUTUBE, regions=US, min-subscribers=50000
Runs bundled helper search-v2 directly without asking for clarification
Presents a readable list (not raw JSON) with name, handle, followers, avg performance
Does NOT run bundled helper parse-v2 before search

evals.prompt: Help me find some influencers for our new skincare brand.
evals.expected_output: Ask for the missing platform and keep region open if it is not needed.
expectations: Does not execute a search before identifying the platform
Asks only for requirements needed for this search
Does not invent a target region

evals.prompt: 我要找一些做美食的 Instagram 博主，主要投中国大陆市场，粉丝 10 万以上的，帮我找 15 个
evals.expected_output: Extract parameters from Chinese input and search directly
expectations: Infers platform=INSTAGRAM
Infers regions=CN
Infers min-subscribers=100000
Presents up to 15 results from the quoted batch without sending a V2 creation limit
Runs bundled helper search-v2 directly without asking for clarification

evals.prompt: Find me TikTok creators similar to this channel: https://www.tiktok.com/@charlidamelio
evals.expected_output: Use bundled helper similar with the provided URL, not a text-based search
expectations: Runs bundled helper similar --url https://www.tiktok.com/@charlidamelio
Does NOT run bundled helper search-v2 instead
Tells the user this may take ~30s before starting
Presents results as a readable shortlist

evals.prompt: Find YouTube channels similar to https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo3m9supEHL8z2nTQaIBs6g but only in US and UK, at least 50k subscribers.
evals.expected_output: Use bundled helper similar with URL and region/follower filters
expectations: Runs bundled helper similar --url ... --regions US,GB --min-subscribers 50000
Does NOT run bundled helper search-v2 instead
Applies the region and follower filters as CLI flags

evals.prompt: What can you tell me about this creator? https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo3m9supEHL8z2nTQaIBs6g
evals.expected_output: Run bundled helper kol with the URL and present the profile
expectations: Runs bundled helper kol --url https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo3m9supEHL8z2nTQaIBs6g
Does NOT run bundled helper search-v2 to find this creator
Reports nickname, follower count, avg performance, language, and email if available
Notes that YouTube creators do not have a region field if relevant

evals.prompt: I want to know the audience breakdown for this YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo3m9supEHL8z2nTQaIBs6g — especially what countries they're from and the age/gender split.
evals.expected_output: Run bundled helper audience and interpret the results
expectations: Runs bundled helper audience --url https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo3m9supEHL8z2nTQaIBs6g
Reports age distribution, gender split, and top audience countries
Includes T1/T2/T3 development level context for regions
Does NOT run bundled helper kol or bundled helper search-v2 instead

evals.prompt: 这个博主的虚假粉丝率高吗？https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo3m9supEHL8z2nTQaIBs6g
evals.expected_output: Run bundled helper audience and interpret the suspectedFakeRate field
expectations: Runs bundled helper audience --url ... to get fakeFollowers data
Interprets suspectedFakeRate: flags >20% as worth noting, >40% as a red flag
Does not just dump the number — explains what it means

evals.prompt: I found this creator during a search. Can you pull their profile AND check their audience quality? https://www.instagram.com/someinfluencer/
evals.expected_output: Run both bundled helper kol and bundled helper audience, combine the results
expectations: Runs bundled helper kol --url ... for the profile
Runs bundled helper audience --url ... for the audience breakdown
Presents both sets of results coherently, not as two separate dumps

evals.prompt: I have a list of YouTube and TikTok creators I want to contact. Can you get their emails? YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo3m9supEHL8z2nTQaIBs6g, TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@someuser
evals.expected_output: Run bundled helper emails with mixed platform flags and share the download URL
expectations: Runs bundled helper emails --yt-urls <yt_url> --tt-urls <tt_url>
Tells the user this is async and may take ~60s
Returns the downloadUrl from the result
Does NOT run bundled helper kol for each URL individually instead

evals.prompt: 批量导出这10个 Instagram 博主的邮箱：https://www.instagram.com/user1/, https://www.instagram.com/user2/, ...
evals.expected_output: Run bundled helper emails --ins-urls with all URLs, report cost and download link
expectations: Runs bundled helper emails --ins-urls <comma-separated-urls>
Notes that 10 URLs will cost 2 quota (1 per 5, rounded up)
Reports the downloadUrl when the task completes

evals.prompt: What are the stats on this video? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ
evals.expected_output: Run bundled helper video with the URL and present the stats
expectations: Runs bundled helper video --url https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ
Reports title, view count, like count, publish date, author name and follower count
Does NOT run bundled helper kol or bundled helper search-v2 instead

evals.prompt: 分析一下这个 TikTok 视频的数据：https://www.tiktok.com/@someuser/video/12345678
evals.expected_output: Run bundled helper video for the TikTok URL
expectations: Runs bundled helper video --url https://www.tiktok.com/@someuser/video/12345678
Reports the available stats (views, likes, author info)
Does NOT claim this URL is unsupported

evals.prompt: Check the share and repost counts for this Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/p/Ddqh7XYm-Rs/
evals.expected_output: Run bundled helper video and report shareCount and repostCount separately
expectations: Runs bundled helper video with the Instagram URL
Reports shareCount and repostCount as distinct metrics
Treats null as unavailable rather than zero
Does NOT substitute repostCount for shareCount

evals.prompt: I just signed up for EasyKOL and want to get started. My API key is ek_live_abc123def456 and my email is user@example.com.
evals.expected_output: Configure the key securely using --key-stdin, never as a visible argument
expectations: Passes a key to the bundled auth command through stdin
Avoids putting the key in command arguments or logs
Confirms setup by running bundled helper doctor afterwards
Does NOT echo or log the key in output to the user

evals.prompt: How do I get started with EasyKOL? I don't have an account yet.
evals.expected_output: Guide through onboarding without exposing CLI commands to the user
expectations: Does NOT expose raw CLI commands to the user
Explains they need an API key from the EasyKOL dashboard
Offers to configure the Skill helper once the user has the key
Does not run any CLI commands until auth is available

evals.prompt: My search failed — it said something about quota being exhausted. How do I fix this?
evals.expected_output: Run quota silently, explain the situation, share top-up URL from action field
expectations: Runs bundled helper quota itself (does not tell user to run it)
Reports remaining credits clearly
Shares action.url from the CLI response if present
Does NOT explain the error technically (no exit code jargon)

evals.prompt: I want to see all the details about this creator — followers, content style, emails, and whether their audience is real. URL: https://www.instagram.com/someinfluencer/
evals.expected_output: Run kol + audience for profile and audience quality; run emails separately only if user explicitly wants exported contact info
expectations: Runs bundled helper kol --url ... for the profile
Runs bundled helper audience --url ... for audience quality (fake followers, region, age/gender)
Does NOT run bundled helper emails unless user explicitly asks for exported email addresses
Treats email from kol profile response as the visible contact signal

evals.prompt: 我想搜一批美妆博主，同时也想知道某个具体 TikTok 账号的受众画像：https://www.tiktok.com/@beautycreator
evals.expected_output: Handle both tasks: search for the batch, audience command for the specific URL
expectations: Runs bundled helper search-v2 for the batch discovery (asks for region/platform if needed)
Runs bundled helper audience --url https://www.tiktok.com/@beautycreator for the specific account
Does NOT conflate the two tasks — handles them separately

evals.prompt: 帮我起草一封给博主的合作邀约邮件，语气专业友好，突出我们产品的卖点。
evals.expected_output: Treat as a copywriting task, not an EasyKOL CLI workflow
expectations: Does NOT invoke easykol CLI for this request
Treats the request as copywriting or content generation
Does not fabricate creator data

evals.prompt: 分析一下抖音平台最近的算法变化对内容创作者有什么影响。
evals.expected_output: Treat as a market analysis question, not an EasyKOL CLI workflow
expectations: Does NOT invoke easykol CLI
Answers the question from general knowledge or declines if outside knowledge cutoff
Does not attempt to use search or kol commands as a substitute

evals.prompt: 帮我把搜到的这些博主信息批量导入到我们公司的 Salesforce CRM。
evals.expected_output: Decline — operating external CRM systems is outside the skill's scope
expectations: Does NOT attempt to use easykol CLI for external CRM operations
Explains that integrating with external CRM is outside the skill's scope
May suggest manually exporting data from emails command as an alternative

evals.prompt: 上次搜 YouTube 健身博主的结果太少了，我想放宽条件——把最低粉丝从 50k 降到 20k，语言还是英语，地区还是美国。
evals.expected_output: Re-run search with adjusted parameters, not ask for all parameters again
expectations: Re-runs bundled helper search-v2 with min-subscribers=20000, keeping regions=US and languages=en
Does NOT ask the user to repeat platform and other already-stated parameters
Presents the new results as a fresh shortlist

evals.prompt: 给我对比分析这两个 YouTube 科技频道，哪个更适合合作？https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCo3m9supEHL8z2nTQaIBs6g 和 https://www.youtube.com/@mkbhd
evals.expected_output: Run kol for both URLs, optionally audience for both, and compare side by side
expectations: Runs bundled helper kol for both URLs
Optionally runs bundled helper audience for both to compare audience quality
Presents a side-by-side comparison rather than two separate reports
Offers a recommendation based on the data

evals.prompt: How much quota do I have left?
evals.expected_output: Run bundled helper quota and report the result in plain language
expectations: Runs bundled helper quota
Reports remaining credits, used credits, and daily limit in plain language
Does not expose the raw JSON

evals.prompt: Find me Instagram creators who post about sustainable fashion, based in Germany or France, with 30k–200k followers.
evals.expected_output: Run search with all inferred parameters directly
expectations: Infers platform=INSTAGRAM, regions=DE,FR, min-subscribers=30000, max-subscribers=200000
Uses sustainable fashion as the sentence
Runs search directly without asking for clarification

evals.prompt: 帮我在韩国找 KOL：AI 工具类博主、职场办公博主、还有 Study with Me 学习博主，Instagram，粉丝 1 万以上。不要加密货币相关的。
evals.expected_output: Use one focused V2 search per distinct niche within the combined quoted budget, then merge and dedup
expectations: Recognizes three distinct niches (AI tools, workplace/career, Study-with-Me) and runs a separate bundled helper search-v2 for each, not one combined sentence
Applies the same shared filters to every sub-search (platform=INSTAGRAM, regions=KR, min-subscribers=10000)
Uses one quoted batch per niche; does not estimate V2 price by displayed --limit
Does NOT create a search for the '不要加密货币' exclusion — treats it as a filter, not a niche
Merges and dedups results by handle / profile URL, presenting them grouped or labelled by niche
Uses --confirm-spend only within explicit user authorization; existing approval persists across turns

evals.prompt: 帮我找20个美国 TikTok 带货达人：粉丝5,000–200,000，全部有公开邮箱，英语13人、西班牙语7人，并且美国受众25–40岁占比至少60%，TikTok Shop履约率达标。导出Excel。
evals.expected_output: Run only the supported search portion and clearly mark the result as partial; do not claim exact audience-age or TikTok Shop fulfilment requirements are verified
expectations: Performs a capability preflight before presenting the result as complete
Recognizes that exact 25–40 audience share cannot be derived from 25–45 buckets
Recognizes that TikTok Shop fulfilment rate is unsupported
Treats has-contact as contact-record presence and verifies actual non-empty email coverage
Does not call 73 or any estimated total a complete candidate pool
Labels any workbook or shortlist as partial / pending platform verification

evals.prompt: 帮我筛选 30 个适合 IFA 展会探展的 YouTube 频道，覆盖德国/法国/意大利/波兰/捷克。
evals.expected_output: One fast YouTube batch with regions DE,FR,IT,PL,CZ; present 30 and stop
expectations: Runs a single bundled helper search-v2 (or asks before any multi-search plan)
Uses regions=DE,FR,IT,PL,CZ (or equivalent one-list form), not five separate country searches
Uses default fast and one batch, quotes batch cost rather than --limit 30
Does NOT start a second wave of expanded/brand-name/re-run searches without user confirmation
Does NOT pass --confirm-spend unless the user approved more spend

evals.prompt: Search failed with exit code 8 saying the search session budget was exceeded. What now?
evals.expected_output: Stop spending, explain the budget stop, offer current partial results if any, ask whether to continue
expectations: Does NOT immediately retry search with --confirm-spend
Explains in plain language that further searches need user approval
Asks the user whether to continue spending before any new paid search
Does not expose raw CLI/JSON jargon as the main answer

evals.prompt: 帮我用 EasyKOL 找 10 个美国 YouTube 健身博主。
evals.expected_output: Use the bundled helper to run one fast V2 batch and present up to 10 results
expectations: Uses the bundled helper doctor and quota; does not install or upgrade a global CLI
Runs one default-fast search with platform=YOUTUBE, regions=US; presents 10 without --limit on creation
Does not start multi-round expansion without asking

evals.prompt: 继续这个 Beta 智能搜索任务，再来一批。外部 V2 已完成任务 task-1，TikTok。预算已批准这一批。
evals.expected_output: Submit exactly one authorized task-bound Pro continuation and read the one-batch quote, currently targeting 30 creators.
expectations: Reads task-1, then uses search-next --task-id task-1 with a new stable idempotency key; inherits beta/platform/filters
Does not send batchCount=3/5 or run parallel pages
Waits for this page before any continuation and stops after the one authorized page
Uses the configured quote; does not treat a platform price multiplier as a batch multiplier

evals.prompt: 当前工具支持 Pro 任务续页。我已经批准最多 4 页及对应报价预算，帮我找最多 150 个，按刚才的条件继续。
evals.expected_output: Continue serially within the authorized four-batch budget and report a shortfall if needed.
expectations: Does not turn 150 into batchCount=3 or limit=150
Reads stored pages for free, preserves source context and chains search-next from each completed child task ID
Stops at the authorized limit and explains that four batches target up to 120, subject to the live quote and actual yield
Does not ask again for each page already authorized and does not broaden filters to fill the target

evals.prompt: 我安装的旧版 easykol CLI，schema --all 只有 search/parse/more-words，没有 task 或 search-next。帮我翻智能搜索 Pro 的下一页。
evals.expected_output: Check the bundled helper and task origin before choosing a continuation without spending on a substitute search.
expectations: Uses or updates the bundled Skill and verifies task origin. For a website task, checks the exact project and task scope or uses the original results page if required.
Does not invent --batch-count, --source-task-id, or a next command
Does not silently run another paid search or change billing contracts
Offers the Pro UI or supported tooling update, not credential extraction

evals.prompt: Pro 下一批提交超时了，不知道是否成功。能不能换个 key 再请求一次？
evals.expected_output: Recover the existing task or retry the same logical page with the same idempotency key.
expectations: Does not create a fresh idempotency key for the uncertain submission
Does not launch the next page while this page is unresolved
Explains how duplicate paid task creation is avoided

evals.prompt: 帮我快速找美国 TikTok 游戏博主，先给 20 个就好。
evals.expected_output: One default fast V2 batch and readable shortlist
expectations: States fast as default, keeps regions in one list
Uses server batch quote, not --limit 20 pricing
Keeps task ID; reads stored pages before paying for another batch

evals.prompt: 普通模式帮我找英国 Instagram 健身博主。
evals.expected_output: Use standard explicitly
expectations: Uses search-v2 --mode standard
Does not silently use fast or beta
Checks returned effectiveParameters and task state

evals.prompt: Beta 模式推广跑步耳机，面向 25–34 岁女性消费者，找测评运动装备的 YouTube 博主。
evals.expected_output: Use beta product requirements without inventing creator demographic hard filters
expectations: Uses --mode beta --product and --audience
Does not set creator gender/age from consumer audience
One batch with optional visual only if requested

evals.prompt: 搜索返回 RESULT_READY，但 settlement.pending=true。可以说已完成退款吗？
evals.expected_output: Read results but keep settlement pending
expectations: Does not call RESULT_READY completed
Does not declare a refund final until pending=false
Polls task for free, never creates another search

evals.prompt: 普通模式找美国 TikTok 美妆达人：粉丝 1 万到 15 万、均播 800 到 7000、最近 30 天发过内容，并且开通了 TikTok Shop 店铺。
evals.expected_output: Use one standard V2 search with the supported numeric, activity, taxonomy and stored-shop filters.
expectations: Uses search-v2 --mode standard with platform=TIKTOK, regions=US and has-tk-shop
Sets min/max subscribers, avg-min/avg-max and last-published-days=30
Uses main-category=beauty when applying a taxonomy filter
Treats TikTok Shop as stored presence rather than live fulfilment verification

evals.prompt: 这个 V2 搜索 keywords 是空数组而且结果是 0，是不是 keywords: [] 把召回清空了？
evals.expected_output: Inspect effective parameters and funnel evidence before assigning causality to an empty keyword list.
expectations: Explains that explicit keywords: [] disables the keyword branch but keeps tag and semantic recall
Checks effectiveParameters and compares one-filter variants before blaming numeric filters
For fast mode, checks virtual-project exclusion degradation separately from a true empty pool
Does not launch a replacement paid search without authorization

evals.prompt: 普通模式找英国 Instagram 健身视频博主，近 30 天发过，视频中位播放 800 到 4000，并且有手机或邮箱。
evals.expected_output: Apply the Instagram median-view range and preserve the direct-contact and activity filters.
expectations: Uses standard mode with --view-min 800 --view-max 4000 --use-median-play-count
Preserves --only-video-creators --has-direct-contact --last-published-days 30 and regions GB
Verifies effective filters and does not reinterpret median views as average views or likes

evals.prompt: 用关键词搜索美国 YouTube 账号，关键词只用 bike fit 和 road cycling，实时数据，一批。
evals.expected_output: Use one V2 keyword batch with explicitly selected realtime data.
expectations: Uses --mode keyword --search-data-mode realtime with the requested terms
Preserves user terms without expanding or changing the selected search mode
Uses the server quote and saves the returned task ID

evals.prompt: 线上搜索准备接口提示 hasVideoCart is not allowed。我要求找有商品锚点的 TikTok 达人。
evals.expected_output: Report that the deployed endpoint rejects the exact required filter and avoid an unfiltered paid search.
expectations: Distinguishes installed command support from production API support
Keeps product-anchor verification pending without substituting TikTok Shop
Does not submit an unfiltered paid search, change modes, or promise deployment

evals.prompt: 帮我把我这个官网搜索项目 P 的历史任务 T 里 NO 的达人导成 Excel，邮箱不要。
evals.expected_output: Download an Excel file from the exact owned website search task with the NO filter.
expectations: Uses search-export with the original task T, project P, --attitude DISLIKE and a new .xlsx output path
Leaves creator emails off
Does not re-run the search, change project ratings or switch to project favorites export
